    - text: Label

      - form "worker config":

          - radiogroup "Harness":
            - text: Harness
            - radio "codex" [checked]
            - text: codex
            - radio "claude"

          - paragraph: Harness that runs the session.
          - group "Session":
            - text: Session Policy
            - combobox "Policy":
              - option "fresh" [selected]
              - option "resume-previous"
              - option "resume-named"
              - option "resume-own"
            - paragraph: Fresh starts an isolated provider conversation with your authored task and selected inputs. Supply current main-loop context deliberately through the prompt, Context input transforms or context files. Resume-own keeps only this node's conversation in this run and harness; its optional reset never clears loop context. Previous and named keep their shared-session behavior.
          - group "Prompt":

            - button "Earlier node outputs (1)"

            - radio "workspace-write" [checked]
            - text: workspace-write
            - radio "danger-full-access"
            - text: danger-full-access
          - paragraph: Sandbox or tool policy. Claude requires an explicit supported policy and provides no OS/read-path confinement.
          - button "Advanced 2 set"
